issue: far-tax-02 is not self-contained: its stem says 'Using the previous item' and omits the pretax income ($600,000), tax-exempt interest ($30,000) and fines ($12,000) needed to answer. Practice sets and review queues are shuffled, so the 'previous item' is usually not far-tax-01. It also shows far-tax-01's key ($111,720) as option (a) and in its explanation, so whichever order they appear in, one item gives away the other's answer.
evidence: src/lib/quiz.ts:84-86 shuffles the eligible items (shuffle(...).sort(by attempts), then shuffle(picked)), and mixed and mastery sets interleave modules (lines 95-98, 114-135). Seen on its own, far-tax-02 gives only the $50,000 depreciation difference, the 21% rate and no beginning balances, so total expense can't be computed. Recomputed with far-tax-01's facts: current (600,000 − 30,000 + 12,000 − 50,000) × 21% = 111,720, deferred 50,000 × 21% = 10,500, total 122,220. That's the key, but it can only be reached with facts from another item. Option (a) '$111,720 — That's only current tax' is far-tax-01's key.
source: Review brief §2 per-MCQ checks 3 and 6 (stem completeness; one item revealing the answer to another)

issue: The journal scorer marks the lesson's own entry format wrong. The lesson's JE block records the provision with two expense lines ('Income tax expense — current' and 'Income tax expense — deferred'). The TBS keys accept only one combined 'Income tax expense' debit, and scoreJournal matches line by line, so a correct entry that splits expense into its current and deferred amounts loses 2 cells.
evidence: Lesson lines 99-107: Dr IT expense—current 159,600; Dr IT expense—deferred 6,300. r3 key: Dr Income tax expense 123,750 / Dr DTA 5,000 / Cr Income taxes payable 113,750 / Cr DTL 15,000. Simulated src/lib/tbsScoring.ts scoreJournal on the response Dr IT expense 113,750, Dr IT expense 10,000, Dr DTA 5,000, Cr ITP 113,750, Cr DTL 15,000 (balanced, 128,750 = 128,750). The expected 123,750 line finds no match (wrong); one IT-expense line is 'blamed' and the other becomes an 'Extra line' (wrong). Result: 3 of 5 cells (60%) for a correct entry. u10 works the same way: 286,650 + 23,100 split across two lines scores 3 of 5 (maxLines 5 allows it).
source: ASC 740-10-50-9 (current and deferred components of tax expense are separately disclosed, so separate lines are standard practice); src/lib/tbsScoring.ts scoreJournal
fix: Do one of the following. (a) Change the lesson's JE block to a single 'Income tax expense 165,900' debit and add a note: 'current 159,600 + deferred 6,300'.
